ledger_amount_sign_matches_type.name: ledger_amount_sign_matches_type
ledger_amount_sign_matches_type.value:
("ledger_entries"."type"::text in ('SALE_CREDIT', 'SALE_REINSTATEMENT', 'PAYOUT_REVERSAL') and "ledger_entries"."amount" > 0)
        or ("ledger_entries"."type"::text in ('SALE_REVERSAL', 'PAYOUT_DEBIT') and "ledger_entries"."amount" < 0)
        or "ledger_entries"."type"::text = 'ADJUSTMENT'

ledger_references_match_type.name: ledger_references_match_type
ledger_references_match_type.value:
("ledger_entries"."type"::text not in ('SALE_CREDIT', 'SALE_REVERSAL', 'SALE_REINSTATEMENT') or "ledger_entries"."order_id" is not null)
        and ("ledger_entries"."type"::text not in ('PAYOUT_DEBIT', 'PAYOUT_REVERSAL') or "ledger_entries"."payout_id" is not null)

orders_captured_has_payment.name: orders_captured_has_payment
orders_captured_has_payment.value: "orders"."status"::text not in ('PAID', 'REFUND_PENDING', 'REFUNDED', 'REFUND_FAILED', 'DISPUTED') or "orders"."provider_payment_id" is not null
